# dsh-bcc · 包拆拆 for DeepSeek Harness
English | 简体中文
Turn a video into a **script**, **storyboard**, or **style guide** inside DeepSeek Harness.
The plugin owns ffmpeg cut detection, keyframes, and export (docx / xlsx / html). **Analysis uses wh
atever model the current DSH session already has.** There is no Gemini/Kimi settings page and no bun
the current DSH session already has.** There is no Gemini/Kimi settings page and no bundled API key.
## Projects
包拆拆 is maintained in two public MIT repositories:
| Repository | Purpose |

| bcc | Desktop application, `bcc` CLI, shared `bcc-core`, and the `bcc` Agent skill |
| dsh-bcc | T
his independently installable DeepSeek Harness plugin, including its tools, web panel, and DSH skill
independently installable DeepSeek Harness plugin, including its tools, web panel, and DSH skills |
Install this repository to use 包拆拆 inside DSH. The desktop application and CLI are available from `b
cc`; they are not required to install or run this plugin. This plugin keeps its video-processing mod
ules locally so a GitHub installation does not depend on a checkout or a private package from `bcc`.
Add or select a model whose DSH catalog declares **image input**, such as Gemini 4 Argon (`gemini-4-
argon`), DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 (`deepseek-flash`), or Kimi K3.1 Pro (`kimi-k3.1-pro`). Availabili
ty follows your account's current catalog. The plugin checks the route actually producing the tool c
all and **prompts you to switch** if it is text-only. It never rewrites your default model. See the
model configuration guide for setup and maintenance.

## Use

1. Expand the right **包拆拆** panel: pick/upload a video, choose 拆剧本 or 拆分镜.
2. **拆剧本** slices the tim
eline every N seconds (default 1s), extracts a beat per still with the open extract prompt, then mer
ges overlapping beats with the open merge prompt. Edit both prompts in the panel; the source files a

re `prompts/script-extract.md` and `prompts/script-merge.md`.
3. **拆分镜** uses smart/scene cuts and s

hot style from the panel.
4. Command palette: `/bcc-script`, `/bcc-storyboard`.
5. Script pipeline:
`bcc_shots cutMethod=interval` → `bcc_read_frames source=shots` until `remaining=0` → merge beats →

`bcc_script_coverage` → `bcc_export`.
6. Storyboard pipeline: `bcc_shots` → `bcc_read_frames source=
shots` → `bcc_export`.

## Compatibility
Version `0.1.7` targets **DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` (npm `latest`) and `0.2.1-rc.2` (npm `next`)**, checked o
n 2026-10-18. Both `engines.dsh` and the DSH tools peer range declare these supported release lines.
DSH `0.1.x` is outside this support range. Pin `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-rc.2` explicitly for the
candidate release, using the same DSH version for plugin installation and `web` startup.
The installation source remains `github:aixlb/dsh-bcc`, and the commands and tools retain their `bcc
` names. Existing workspace data in `.dsh-bcc/projects`, uploaded videos, and saved panel preference
s remain in place. The plugin does not move desktop/CLI projects into the DSH workspace or change th
e current session model.
The panel and prompt submission bind to their originating session. Tools follow the session's effect
ive working directory, including `working_directory` changes; relative inputs and outputs resolve th
ere. Read-only tools permit DSH's parallel scheduling. Cutting, project edits, and exports remain ex
clusive. Canonical JSON and image output works with Native and PTC presentation. See the compatibili
ty assessment for changes and feature decisions.
## Development
Use Node.js 22.19+ in the 22.x series, or Node.js 24+. Install ffmpeg and ffprobe on `PATH` to run t
he video smoke test; you can also set `BCC_FFMPEG_PATH` and `BCC_FFPROBE_PATH`. At runtime the plugi
n can resolve or download these binaries on first use.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`check` runs TypeScript checks, tests, and a package dry run. `npm run build` produces the server an
d browser entries in `lib/`; `npm pack` creates an installable archive with the prompts, DSH skills,
and Cordis patch. The `prepare` script also builds the plugin when installing from GitHub.
| Directory | Purpose |

| `src/lib/` | Video processing, exports, prompt loading, and model capability checks |
| `src/tools

/`, `src/commands.ts`, `src/skills/` | DSH tools, commands, and skill registration |
| `src/client/`

, `src/http/` | DSH web panel and workspace endpoints |
| `src/store/` | Existing `.dsh-bcc` project

storage |
| `skills/`, `prompts/` | Packaged DSH instructions and editable script prompts |
Changes to video-processing behavior can be coordinated with `bcc-core` in the main repository. DSH
model access and workspace integration are maintained here.
